evidence.title: RWKV Language Model
evidence.content: RWKV ## RWKV Language Model Github Twitter Discord RWKV (pronounced RwaKuv) is an RNN with great LLM performance and parallelizable like a Transformer. Check RWKV-7 "Goose" reasoning models. It's combining the best of RNN and transformer - great performance, linear time, constant space (no kv-cache), fast training, infinite ctxlen, and free text embedding. evidence.title: RWKV: Reinventing RNNs for the Transformer Era
evidence.content: Computer Science > Computation and Language Title:RWKV: Reinventing RNNs for the Transformer Era View PDF HTML (experimental)Abstract:Transformers have revolutionized almost all natural language processing (NLP) tasks but suffer from memory and computational complexity that scales quadratically with sequence length. In contrast, recurrent neural networks (RNNs) exhibit linear scaling in memory and computational requirements but struggle to match the same performance as Transformers due to limitations in parallelization and scalability. arXivLabs: experimental projects with community collaborators arXivLabs is a framework that allows collaborators to develop and share new arXiv features directly on our website.
